root_cause: Obligation Terminal Closure required exact-head Brain evidence through Unified Brain Delivery even when no exact-head Unified Brain run existed for that candidate. Waiting only on that unavailable evidence path could deadlock terminal closure despite Required, Skill Projection and CodeQL already being green.
fix: Use an attainable evidence hierarchy: prefer an existing exact-head Unified Brain run; when none exists, wait for Brain foundation verify on the merged commit SHA and require that run to complete successfully. Keep failure and timeout states fail-closed.
prevention: Prefer the strongest exact-head gate evidence when it exists.
When a workflow run cannot exist for that candidate/event, use an explicitly defined equivalent canonical evidence source rather than polling an impossible run.
Equivalent fallback evidence must remain fail-closed: failed or non-terminal Brain foundation evidence blocks closure.
Required, CodeQL, learning/skill and provider/readback gates remain independently enforced.

evidence.stuck_step: Verify exact-head critical delivery gates before terminal claim
evidence.unavailable_evidence_path: Unified Brain Delivery exact-head PR run
evidence.fallback_evidence_path: Brain foundation verify on merge SHA
